purpose: Two real API integration episodes, not efficacy or final benchmark validation
second_consumer: the uninvolved agent after the first uniform draw
agent_initial_state: same model, prompts, limits; no preset expertise
history_rule: controller stores attributable judgment and action only; second consumer receives first evidence; model calls otherwise fresh; no skills or code memory
source_review: human/agent static inspection of sealed source before sandbox execution; no introspection or external IO

update.kind: integration-only judgment action score, no trained model
update.terminal_role: requires observed completion; not used as producer correctness target

stop_rules: first episode incomplete, invalid or UNKNOWN: no second episode
any malformed, truncated or empty model response: no retry
two planned attempts exhausted: do not top up to four
budget_accounting: attempts count toward N02 limit4 and N03 total24; no GPU
